title: get_status_endpoint_should_return_server_status
description: Verify that GET /status returns HTTP 200 with JSON body {"ok": true, "status": "UP"} when the server is running normally.

title: post_auth_e2e_login_should_create_session_cookie_and_return_success
description: Verify that POST /auth/e2e/login with valid user data returns HTTP 200 with {"ok": true, "message": "E2E login successful"} and sets an httpOnly session cookie.

title: post_auth_e2e_login_should_return_404_when_e2e_mode_disabled
description: Verify that POST /auth/e2e/login returns HTTP 404 with {"error": "E2E test mode is not enabled"} when E2E mode is disabled.

title: get_auth_me_should_return_401_without_session_cookie
description: Verify that GET /auth/me without a valid session cookie returns HTTP 401 with {"error": "Unauthenticated"}.

title: get_auth_me_should_return_user_info_with_valid_session_cookie
description: Verify that GET /auth/me with a valid session cookie returns HTTP 200 with the current authenticated user's id, email, and name.

title: post_api_support_run_should_return_401_without_session_cookie
description: Verify that POST /api/support/run without a valid session cookie returns HTTP 401 with {"error": "Unauthenticated"}.

title: post_api_support_run_should_succeed_with_valid_session_cookie
description: Verify that POST /api/support/run with a valid session cookie returns HTTP 200 indicating the operation was accepted.
